# inline_forms

**Tag**: web

## 简介

Inline Forms eases setup of admin-style forms with inline editing. Field lists are declared on the model. Requires Rails 8.1.x, Ruby >= 4.0, and validation_hints ~> 8.

- 主页: http://github.com/acesuares/inline_forms

- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/inline_forms
